articles.summary: Join us for a light-hearted chat with Olive and Wee, the creative couple behind Bichi Mao. In our second creator interview blog, we dive into the fun and inspiration that birthed this beloved character, exploring their journey in the vibrant world of character design. Get ready for some delightful insights and stories from the creators of Bichi Mao!
articles.title: Creator Interview #2 - Olive and Wee, the creators of Bichi Mao
